```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

class DataCleaning:
    def __init__(self):
        self.actions_log = []

    def clean(self, data: pd.DataFrame):
        # Clip outliers / right-censoring 
        self.actions_log.append("Clipping VehAge (<=20), DrivAge (<=90), BonusMalus (<=150), ClaimNb (<=5).")
        data['VehAge'] = data['VehAge'].clip(upper=20)
        data['DrivAge'] = data['DrivAge'].clip(upper=90)
        data['BonusMalus'] = data['BonusMalus'].clip(upper=150)
        data['ClaimNb'] = data['ClaimNb'].clip(upper=5)

        # Encode categorical variables
        data['Area'] = pd.get_dummies(data['Area'], drop_first=True)
        data['VehBrand'] = pd.get_dummies(data['VehBrand'], drop_first=True)
        data['VehGas'] = pd.get_dummies(data['VehGas'], drop_first=True)
        data['Region'] = pd.get_dummies(data['Region'], drop_first=True)

        self.actions_log.append("Encoded Area, VehBrand, VehGas, Region categories using one-hot encoding.")

        # Scale numeric variables
        scaler = StandardScaler()
        numeric_cols = ['VehPower', 'VehAge', 'DrivAge', 'BonusMalus', 'Density', 'Exposure']
        data[numeric_cols] = scaler.fit_transform(data[numeric_cols])

        self.actions_log.append("Scaled numeric variables using StandardScaler.")

        # Remove missing values
        empty_cols = data.columns[data.isna().all()].tolist()
        if empty_cols:
            data = data.drop(columns=empty_cols)
        
        data = data.dropna()

        return data
```
